profile.headline: Experienced software engineer at Spotify
profile.summary: Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience and demonstrated history of working on projects in multiple diverse industries including IT security, finance, and textiles, focused heavily on user interface development with Javascript and React.

positions.description: React UI development with Apollo and various other front end libraries

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: - Software Engineer working in the Data Collection and Assessment department building React UIs using Apollo, Redux, Webpack, ES6, etc. Also, have worked on and contributed to Java Spring APIs and a Java GraphQL service

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated on full stack Ruby on Rails ERP system for textile manufacturer, integrating with external order management system to reduce number of licenses needed and improve ease of use. 
- Worked server-side on a portfolio management system for a consignment business, linking with legacy FileMaker databases, square register app for in-store sales and a direct deposit payment system. 
- Contributed to Python REST API and GraphQl API for large scale custom stationary and art printing application 
- Built C# .Net application that collected and distributed third party, real time financial data to a front end stock ticker application. Worked on C# WebAPI using Entity Framework for ERP system
- Tech Lead on ReactJS client side development for alternative capital markets trading system using ES6, Redux, RxJS, and Jest testing.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: - Participated in a 12-week immersive back-end web development program in Ruby on Rails
